builds.name: Reference: Range and poke
builds.goal: Reference for Orianna: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ball-positioning control mage who layers area pressure with allied protection and a displacement ultimate. Record ball position and allied delivery rather than assuming a perfect R cluster. Support shielding sacrifices spell damage and must be judged by actual ally survival. Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
builds.summary: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
testPlan: Kit question for Orianna: Record ball position and allied delivery rather than assuming a perfect R cluster. Support shielding sacrifices spell damage and must be judged by actual ally survival.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Horizon) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.

The route fails Orianna's stated kit question: Record ball position and allied delivery rather than assuming a perfect R cluster. Support shielding sacrifices spell damage and must be judged by actual ally survival.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.
Full cost 16,050 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Luden, then Horizon. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

Orianna commands her Ball to release an electric pulse, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Orianna's Attacks deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 50; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × AP] magic damage. Subsequent Attacks against the same target within [4] seconds deal an additional [(characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 50; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × AP) × (0.15)] magic damage (max of [(characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 50; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × AP) × ((0.15) × (2))] damage).

Orianna commands her Ball to move to an area, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage to surrounding enemies and to enemies it passes through. Deals [30]% less damage to all enemies after the first.
Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing [225 / 350 / 475 + (1.1) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies and Knocking them in the direction of the Ball.

builds.name: Self-ball windup
builds.summary: Keep the ball on Orianna while ramping same-target attacks.
builds.goal: Keep the ball on Orianna while ramping same-target attacks.
builds.hypothesis: Clockwork Windup's AP magic damage increases across attacks on one target within four seconds. Self E adds shield and ball resists while W supplies escape speed. Nashor supports attacks; Dusk provides one spell-followed attack and Cosmic reacts to magic packets.
testPlan: Required state: Ball attached to self, stable attack target and less than four seconds between attacks.
Measure first three passive attack packets and damage prevented by self E while alternating versus holding targets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Attack range forces exposure or repeated target switching discards passive ramp.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeating an on-hit does not establish an extra Clockwork Windup stack.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Protect then pulse
builds.summary: Use an ally ball carrier to distribute utility and damage in one engagement.
builds.goal: Use an ally ball carrier to distribute utility and damage in one engagement.
builds.hypothesis: E shields and supplies attached resists; Staff rewards allied shielding with AP/haste, then W and R originate at the ally's ball. Helia requires Orianna's champion damage before the next E shield. Shurelya supports the carrier's entry; AP improves shield and pulse damage.
testPlan: Required state: An allied diver carries the ball within tether range and E is available after champion damage.
Record ball position, shield amount and Helia consumption for E-before-damage versus damage-before-E.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Automatic ball return invalidates placement or the ally dies before shielding.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Ball attachment does not transfer Orianna's items to the carrier.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.

Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
